# Daily Field Dispatch and Relay Log
Central Dispatch Desk 4 - Metro Utilities Authority
Date: 04/16/2026

## Active Field Units
| Unit ID | Lead Tech | Radio Channel | Assigned Area | Service Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Truck 12 | Marcus Vance | VHF-Channel 3 | North Sector | Gas Main Valve Repair |
| Truck 18 | Sarah Lin | VHF-Channel 5 | South Sector | Water Service Lateral |
| Truck 27 | Kevin O'Shea | VHF-Channel 3 | East District | Leak Survey |
| Unit 40 | Elena Ramos | VHF-Channel 8 | West District | Gas Meter Replacement |

## Work Order Relays and Status Updates
- 08:15 - Relayed urgent repair order WO-4409 to Truck 12 via VHF-Channel 7 regarding odor complaints at 742 Elm Street.
- 08:42 - Field Inspector Davis called desk via landline to request immediate emergency shutdown of 8-inch cast iron water main at 14th & Oak.
- 08:46 - Radioed Truck 18 to isolate the Oak Street water grid and notify affected businesses.
- 09:10 - Relayed message from Truck 27: minor surface leak identified at 310 Pine Road; requested vac-truck support.
- 09:35 - Supervisor Morris authorized vac-truck deployment for Pine Road job; dispatched Vac-2 to location.

## Safety Notices and Permits
- 09:50 - Relayed active excavation safety hold on East District jobs due to high wind advisory, and instructed Truck 27 to commence trench excavation immediately.
- 10:15 - Broadcast atmospheric testing reminder to all gas crews working in confined vaults.
- 10:40 - Relayed hot-work clearance permit CP-882 to Unit 40 for regulator station work valid until 16:00 without recording ambient gas level verification.

errors.fix: Relayed urgent repair order WO-4409 to Truck 12 via VHF-Channel 3 regarding odor complaints

errors.quote: safety hold on East District jobs due to high wind advisory, and instructed Truck 27 to commence trench excavation immediately
errors.explanation: The dispatcher relays an excavation safety hold for the East District but simultaneously instructs Truck 27, which is operating in the East District, to begin trench excavation.
errors.fix: safety hold on East District jobs due to high wind advisory, and instructed Truck 27 to suspend all trench excavation

errors.quote: Relayed hot-work clearance permit CP-882 to Unit 40 for regulator station work valid until 16:00 without recording ambient gas level verification.
errors.explanation: Hot-work permits for gas utility work require logging the verified ambient combustible gas / LEL reading before authorizing work to proceed.
errors.fix: Relayed hot-work clearance permit CP-882 to Unit 40 for regulator station work valid until 16:00 with verified 0.0% LEL ambient gas test.
